name: EngineeringChangeOrder
tagline: ECR/ECO impact, effectivity, stock disposition, CCB approvals and implementation in one PCF control
description: A production-grade engineering change control for Power Apps and Power Pages: affected parts and revisions, date/serial/lot/use-up effectivity, stock, WIP and open-order disposition with scrap and rework cost exposure, sequential or parallel CCB approvals and a department checklist with stage gates.
features: Change list with KPIs and action-needed sorting
Impact & disposition per affected part with cost exposure
Effectivity by date, serial, lot or stock run-out
Sequential or parallel CCB approvals with mandatory reject comments
Implementation checklist by department with overdue flags
Outputs and DOM event for flows and scripts
